decisions.evidence: Focused current-content and candidate historical-source review: explicit triangular row recurrences solve the same two unique triangular systems already named by the original algorithm, and F13/3.1 identifies their unchanged backward gain before the same Gaussian mixture construction. No mathematical defect was confirmed; T=0 returns the initialized pair and singular forecast remains excluded. Native reader and Alpha reports remain unchanged; exact historical candidate authentication is reserved to root.
